title: datum import row
description: One entry, one line of a JSONL file `datum import` reads and `datum export --jsonl` prints. docs/import.md is the spec in full.

oneOf.description: A time as `datum -t` reads it: 2026-11-10T08:30:00+01:00, or 2026-11-10 08:30 in --tz's zone, else the machine's.
The object export prints. With no offset_minutes, the zone is `timezone`, else --tz's, else the machine's.

uncertainty.description: How precisely the time is known, an ISO 8601 duration such as PT5M.

field.description: What is tracked: coffee, mood, sleep.

at.description: When. Required for a timed entry: one with a state, a dur or a following_state, or of a field whose kind is timed. For a period, its END.

state.description: The state an on/off or change field takes at `at` (true, false, "happy"), or a moment's quantity.

dur.description: How long it lasted, ending at `at`: an ISO 8601 duration (PT30M), 30m, 1:30, or seconds. MOMENT for a moment.

following_state.description: The state after a period's or moment's trailing edge; needs a dur.

data.description: Any other keys of the entry. No key named at.

verb.description: The stored shape. Derived from state, dur and following_state; given, it must be what they make.

create_time.description: When it was logged, kept as the entry's own. Omitted, the import's time.

raw_input.description: The command line that logged it, if one did.

extra_metadata.description: datum's own provenance, as export prints it.

user_asserted_last_state.description: The state being left, as -l records it.

deleted_at.description: A deleted entry is not imported.

hid.description: Derived by the import, and ignored.

slug.description: Derived by the import, and ignored.

id_structure.description: Derived by the import, and ignored.

content_hash.description: Derived by the import, and ignored.

client_id.description: Derived by the import, and ignored.

modify_time.description: Derived by the import, and ignored.
